title: Random forest screening finds TRPA1-activating flavor compounds confirmed in cell assays
summary: A random forest model predicted and screened flavor compounds for TRPA1 activation, and selected candidates showed dose-dependent channel activation in calcium flux assays in a newly constructed TRPA1 cell line. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations suggested key interacting residues. The abstract does not state the number of compounds tested.
ai_technology: Optimized Random Forest model predicting TRPA1 activation by flavor compounds

evidence.tested: Calcium flux assays in a new TRPA1 cell line confirmed dose-dependent activation by the selected candidates.
evidence.unknown: Number of candidates and potency values are not stated; docking and dynamics results are supportive only. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A random forest screened flavor compounds for TRPA1 activity before wet-lab testing.
